gloss: to hold, to have, to carry

definitions.explanation: To have something in one's hands or to carry something. Physical possession or holding.
To own or possess something. {車|くるま}を{持|も}っている (to have a car).
For something to remain in good condition or to endure. この{電池|でんち}は{長|なが}く{持|も}つ (this battery lasts long).

notes:
{持|も}つ covers holding something in the hand, carrying it, and owning it. A third sense — of food, batteries, or weather — means to last or hold up.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}つ (hold, carry, or have X)
- No transitivity pair. Sense 3 (to last) is used intransitively: ⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{持|も}つ

ASPECT (ている):
- {持|も}っている is a resulting state, not an action in progress
- It is the ordinary way to say "has" or "owns," far more common than the plain form for possession

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}つ (carry luggage)
- ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}っている (have an umbrella)
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}っている (own a car)
- ⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧{持|も}つ (last a long time)

SIMILAR VERBS:
- ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ states that something exists; {持|も}つ says who owns or carries it
- ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ is picking something up; {持|も}つ is having it in hand afterward

Godan verb; the te-form is {持|も}って.
